diagnosis: The customer asks whether a custom SLA exists on their account. The entitlements explicitly include 'custom_sla' and an sla_hours value of 4, confirming they have a premium custom SLA. No escalation is needed; the information is available in the entitlements payload.
reply: Hi there, thanks for reaching out. Yes, your Enterprise account does include a custom SLA. You are on our Premium support tier, which provides priority routing and a four‑hour first‑response target during business hours in the eu‑central region. You can also confirm this in the features listed for your account under your support plan details.
